typeSpecimen.rule: every open part switch on; an open locus at the species' typical copies where the frame names them (its proportions by kind), else numeric loci at the middle of their pool and categorical loci at the first allele
typeSpecimen.brief: Kilpo: 1 body region (B1), a head, 2 eyes, two antennae, 4 legs; scales, bands; plantigrade, neck head.

viability.rule: random copies from the species pools at every open locus, and children of crosses between members (their blends on the step between the named alleles); built by the rig and validated against the compositional contract
